title: HTML Forms: Collecting User Input
description: Learn how HTML forms work, how to choose the right input controls, and how to build a clean, accessible contact form with practical HTML and CSS.

homework.title: Build your own registration form
homework.description: Create a responsive registration form using labels, text inputs, email, password, date, select, radio buttons, checkboxes, textarea, and a submit button. Keep the markup semantic and make the form comfortable to use on mobile devices.
